Immortal Brain v5.0

An autonomous and proactive AI agent for intelligent task management, featuring automated workflows, rapid feedback, and continuous learning.

Fully Autonomous AI Agent: Introduction of a comprehensive automated workflow encompassing research, analysis, planning, and execution.

Feedback Loop Implementation: Features a 6-minute timeout with an auto-approval mechanism for seamless task continuity.

Real-Time Monitoring System: Includes percentage-based progress reporting and urgent task alerts triggered every 2 minutes.

 Expanded Architecture: Organized task-specific memory, automated connections, user profiling, and creative suggestions powered by historical experience.

Automated Commands: Streamlined triggers for the processing, listing, and monitoring of all active tasks.
